assumptions.condition: The arrays \(\{Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1):i\in\mathcal I_n\}\) are fixed under assignment, with one version of each treatment and no interference.
There is a constant \(K_0<\infty\), independent of \(n\), such that \(\max_{i\in\mathcal I_n}\{\|x_{ni}\|+|Y_{ni}(0)|+|Y_{ni}(1)|\}\le K_0\).
The finite-population covariance matrix of \(\bigl(x_{ni}^{\mathsf T},Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1)\bigr)^{\mathsf T}\) converges entrywise to a finite matrix.
There is a constant \(c_x>0\) such that \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\lambda_{\min}(S_{xx,n})\ge c_x\).

standard.name: Uniform positive definiteness of the covariate covariance

assumptions.condition: The every-row outcome-sum projection-residual variance satisfies \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}v_n\ge c_s\).

novel.justification: This is the explicitly scoped design-relevance condition that keeps the stationary outcome-residual coordinate nondegenerate and makes its standardization meaningful. It is satisfied by bounded triangular arrays whose outcome-sum component retains variation orthogonal to the fixed-dimensional covariate span; degenerate residual sequences are outside this paper's declared scope and are not covered by the Li--Ding regression-adjustment citation.

definitions.name: Bounded equal-allocation PSRR array class
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}=\{(n,k,(x_{ni},Y_{ni}(0),Y_{ni}(1))_{i=1}^n)_{n\in2\mathbb N}:\text{ ass:centered-covariates, ass:fixed-potential-outcomes, ass:uniform-boundedness, ass:second-moment-limit, ass:covariate-nondegeneracy, and ass:residual-nondegeneracy hold}\}\).

definitions.name: Deterministic regular tail
definitions.construction: \(N_0=\min\{N\in2\mathbb N:\text{ for every }n\in2\mathbb N\text{ with }n\ge N,\ \lambda_{\min}(S_{xx,n})\ge c_x/2,\ v_n\ge c_s/2,\text{ and }\#\{w\in\mathcal A_n:\|n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(2w_i-1)S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}x_{ni}\|^2\le a\}\ge1\}\). Every inverse, whitened score, standardized score, algorithm, and asymptotic claim is indexed only by even \(n\ge N_0\); the finitely many rows \(n<N_0\) are discarded and have no asymptotic role.

definitions.name: Acceptable allocation set and initialization probability
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), \(\mathcal A_n(a)=\{w\in\mathcal A_n:M_n(w)\le a\}\) and \(p_n=\#\mathcal A_n(a)/\#\mathcal A_n=\Pr\{M_n(W_{n,0})\le a\}\).

definitions.name: Original first-entry PSRR
definitions.construction: For each even \(n\ge N_0\), for which \(\mathcal A_n(a)\neq\varnothing\), draw \(W_{n,0}\) uniformly from \(\mathcal A_n\). While \(M_n(W_{n,m})>a\), draw one treated index and one control index uniformly, propose their transposition \(W^*\), accept it with probability \(\min\{1,(M_n(W_{n,m})/M_n(W^*))^{\gamma}\}\) with every improving move and every move to \(M_n(W^*)=0\) accepted, count every proposal including rejections, and stop at \(T_n=\inf\{m\ge0:M_n(W_{n,m})\le a\}\). The chain is evaluated only through this first entry.

definitions.name: Finite-population ATE and terminal difference in means
Whitened joint covariate--residual score
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), let \(d_{ni}=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}x_{ni}\), \(b_n=S_{dh,n}=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}S_{xh,n}\), \(s_n=\sqrt{v_n}\), \(r_{ni}=\{h_{ni}-\bar h_n-b_n^{\mathsf T}d_{ni}\}/s_n\), and \(q_{ni}=(d_{ni}^{\mathsf T},r_{ni})^{\mathsf T}\). Define \(Z_n(w)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n(2w_i-1)q_{ni}=(D_n(w)^{\mathsf T},E_n(w))^{\mathsf T}\).

definitions.name: Proposal-time absorbed score path
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), \(\bar Z_n(t)=Z_n(W_{n,\min\{\lfloor nt\rfloor,T_n\}})\) for \(t\ge0\).

definitions.name: Actual-filtration characteristic handle
definitions.construction: Couple the all-pairs extension of original PSRR by common transpositions to a stationary uniform-allocation shadow; before first entry, use exact centering of the antisymmetric Metropolis-kink score against the deterministic population empirical measure to control drift and cross-characteristics uniformly along localized proposal-time paths. Analyze the single terminal crossing directly from its exact transposition increment and the vanishing jump size, without invoking the singular drift expansion at or after \(T_n\).

definitions.name: Candidate stopped diffusion system
definitions.construction: Before \(H=\inf\{t\ge0:\|D_t\|^2\le a\}\), \(dD_t=(-4D_t-8\gamma D_t/\|D_t\|^2)dt+\sqrt8\,dB_t\) and \(dE_t=-4E_tdt+\sqrt8\,dB'_t\), with \(D_0=G\), \(E_0=\varepsilon\), and \(G,\varepsilon,B,B'\) mutually independent; absorb both coordinates at \(H\).

definitions.name: Radially clipped Gaussian
definitions.construction: \(C_{k,a}=G\min\{1,\sqrt a/\|G\|\}\), with the multiplier defined as \(1\) at \(G=0\).

definitions.name: Residual variance envelope
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\) and \(z\in\{0,1\}\), let \(\beta_{z,n}=S_{xx,n}^{-1}S_{x,Y(z),n}\) and \(e_{z,ni}=Y_{ni}(z)-\bar Y_n(z)-\beta_{z,n}^{\mathsf T}x_{ni}\). Set \(u_n=2S_{e_1e_1,n}+2S_{e_0e_0,n}\), so algebraically \(u_n-s_n^2=S_{e_1-e_0,e_1-e_0,n}\ge0\).

definitions.name: Stopped-design estimators of envelope inputs
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), within each observed arm compute the centered outcome--covariate covariance \(\widehat c_{z,n}\) and the intercept-including OLS residual mean square \(\widehat S_{e_z,n}^2\), using the Moore--Penrose fit on singular samples. Set \(\widehat b_n=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}(\widehat c_{1,n}+\widehat c_{0,n})\) and \(\widehat u_n=2\widehat S_{e_1,n}^2+2\widehat S_{e_0,n}^2\).

definitions.name: Computable variance-envelope critical value
definitions.construction: For \(v,B_0\ge0\), define \(q_{\alpha}(v,B_0)=\inf\{t\ge0:\Pr(|\sqrt v\,\varepsilon+B_0(C_{k,a})_1|\le t)\ge1-\alpha\}\) and \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,B_0)=\max_{0\le v\le u}q_{\alpha}(v,B_0)\). Compute it by Gaussian--spherical integration, scalar quantile search, and compact one-dimensional maximization.

definitions.name: Variance-envelope ATE interval
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), \(I_n=[\widehat\tau_n-q_{*,\alpha}(\widehat u_n,\|\widehat b_n\|)/\sqrt n,\ \widehat\tau_n+q_{*,\alpha}(\widehat u_n,\|\widehat b_n\|)/\sqrt n]\).

definitions.name: Fully interacted terminal estimator
definitions.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{Lin},n}\) is the coefficient on treatment in the OLS regression of the observed outcome on an intercept, treatment, centered covariates, and all treatment--covariate interactions under \(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}}\).

statements.statement: The index \(N_0\) in def:regular-tail is finite. More precisely, on the eventual positive-definite covariance tail, the finite-population Gaussian initialization gives \(D_n(W_{n,0})\Rightarrow G\) and hence \(p_n=\Pr\{M_n(W_{n,0})\le a\}\to\Pr(\|G\|^2\le a)>0\). Therefore \(\mathcal A_n(a)\neq\varnothing\), \(S_{xx,n}\) is positive definite, and \(s_n=\sqrt{v_n}>0\) for every even \(n\ge N_0\). Because the balanced pair-swap graph is finite and connected and every required transition has positive probability for finite \(\gamma\), \(T_n<\infty\) almost surely on this retained tail; the discarded rows \(n<N_0\) have no asymptotic role.
statements.justification: This derives, rather than assumes, that every retained experiment has a reachable first-entry target and valid score normalization.
statements.gap: Finite-population central limit theory supplies Gaussian initialization, but original PSRR asymptotics require the additional deterministic-tail consequence that the fixed-radius acceptable set is eventually nonempty.
statements.consumer: The lemma makes the stopping time, pre-entry characteristics, terminal allocation, and all subsequent causal limits well posed on one deterministic asymptotic tail.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), uniform equal allocation gives \(Z_n(W_{n,0})\Rightarrow\mathcal N_{k+1}(0,I_{k+1})\), and the score construction satisfies \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)=b_n^{\mathsf T}D_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}})+s_nE_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}})\) exactly.
statements.justification: This identifies the complete-randomization initialization and the exact causal decomposition that the stopped process must transport.
statements.gap: Li and Ding give the finite-population vector CLT at a fixed complete-randomization draw, not along the Zhu--Liu first-entry path.
statements.consumer: The joint normalization supplies the initial law for the stopped martingale problem and the ATE scaling used by every later interval result.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), does the actual-filtration characteristic handle establish, for every fixed \(L,R<\infty\), uniformly over integers \(0\le m<\min\{\lfloor nL\rfloor,T_n\}\) with \(\|Z_n(W_{n,m})\|\le R\), that \(n\,\mathbb E(\Delta Z_{n,m}\mid\mathcal F_{n,m})+4Z_n(W_{n,m})+8\gamma(D_n(W_{n,m})^{\mathsf T},0)^{\mathsf T}/\|D_n(W_{n,m})\|^2\to0\) in probability, \(n\,\mathbb E(\Delta Z_{n,m}\Delta Z_{n,m}^{\mathsf T}\mid\mathcal F_{n,m})\to8I_{k+1}\) in probability, and the conditional jump Lindeberg remainder tends to zero, without empirical-law convergence, projected Markovianity, stabilization, or outcome-residual independence; and can the terminal crossing be transferred separately from its exact transposition increment and vanishing jump size, without using \(D/\|D\|^2\) at or after \(T_n\)?
statements.justification: This is the first nonroutine proof boundary: the projected scores are generally non-Markov and the Metropolis kink can create an order-one residual drift at arbitrary balanced states.
statements.gap: Roberts, Gelman, and Gilks control Metropolis characteristics for high-dimensional product targets; no located theorem provides these actual-path finite-population exchange bounds for original PSRR.
statements.consumer: An affirmative answer supplies pre-entry predictable characteristics and a separate terminal-crossing argument for compact containment, martingale-problem identification, and continuous first-hit transfer.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), jointly in \(D([0,\infty),\mathbb R^{k+1})\times[0,\infty)\), \(\bigl(\bar Z_n,T_n/n\bigr)\Rightarrow\bigl((D_{t\wedge H}^{\mathsf T},E_{t\wedge H})^{\mathsf T},H\bigr)\), where the limit is the unique weak solution in def:limit-system and \(H<\infty\) almost surely.
statements.justification: The theorem converts the original allocation algorithm into a joint proposal-time process law without assuming that its low-dimensional projection is Markov.
statements.gap: Zhu and Liu explicitly leave asymptotic distributions of common PSRR statistics open, and Lu, Zhang, and Zhu study a stationary chain with a correction rather than this first-entry process.
statements.consumer: Users of the original equal-allocation PSRR implementation obtain its first-order search-time distribution and a valid stopping transfer for downstream statistics.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), for every fixed finite \(\gamma\ge0\), \(\bigl(D_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}}),E_n(W_{n,\mathrm{stop}})\bigr)\Rightarrow(C_{k,a},\varepsilon)\), where \(C_{k,a}\) and \(\varepsilon\) are independent. Hence \(\|C_{k,a}\|^2=\min\{\chi_k^2,a\}\), with boundary mass \(1-\Pr(\chi_k^2\le a)\); consequently, for finite \(a\), this law is not the classical uniform-rerandomization law \(L_{k,a}\), which gives the boundary sphere probability zero. The law of \(H\) may depend on \(\gamma\), but the displayed terminal law does not.
statements.justification: The radial boundary component and pathwise residual independence are the design-specific features hidden by stationary or conditional approximations.
statements.gap: Classical Mahalanobis rerandomization yields a Gaussian conditioned inside the ball; no located result derives the radial first-entry clipping law for original PSRR.
statements.consumer: The explicit endpoint law permits direct power, variance, and critical-value calculations for a design that currently has only Fisher sharp-null inference.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), the terminal covariate limit satisfies the following distinction. For every finite \(a>0\), the terminal covariate limit \(C_{k,a}\) is not equal in distribution to the classical uniform-rerandomization limit \(L_{k,a}\): the former assigns mass \(1-\Pr(\chi_k^2\le a)\) to the sphere \(\{d:\|d\|^2=a\}\), whereas the latter assigns that sphere probability zero.
statements.justification: A boundary-atom certificate prevents the original first-entry output from being silently replaced by a uniform acceptable-set draw.
statements.gap: Li, Ding, and Rubin characterize uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization, while Lu, Zhang, and Zhu restore that uniform law only after changing the algorithm.
statements.consumer: Analysts can diagnose exactly why truncated-Gaussian reference intervals are not calibrated for uncorrected first-entry PSRR.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), if \(b_n\to b\) and \(s_n\to s\), then \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)\Rightarrow b^{\mathsf T}C_{k,a}+s\varepsilon\), with \(C_{k,a}\perp\varepsilon\).
statements.justification: This is the requested common-statistic limit for the finite-population ATE under the actual terminal assignment.
statements.gap: Zhu and Liu prove unbiasedness and a variance-reduction lower bound but explicitly leave this asymptotic distribution to future work.
statements.consumer: The theorem turns the original PSRR design into an asymptotically analyzable ATE procedure under heterogeneous effects.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), every treated- and control-arm empirical mean entering def:observable-envelope-inputs differs from its finite-population counterpart by \(o_{\Pr}(1)\) at \(T_n\). Consequently, \(\widehat b_n-b_n\to_{\Pr}0\) and \(\widehat u_n-u_n\to_{\Pr}0\).
statements.justification: Adaptive first entry selects the terminal arms through the whole covariate path, so fixed-draw laws of large numbers cannot simply be conditioned on acceptance.
statements.gap: Li and Ding establish armwise regression quantities under uniform rerandomization; the stopped nonuniform PSRR design has no published uniform path law.
statements.consumer: The result makes all projection and variance inputs in the proposed interval computable from the realized experiment.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), the maximum in \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,B_0)\) exists, its defining integral is computable, and the interval \(I_n\) obeys the sequencewise design-based guarantee \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\Pr(\tau_n\in I_n)\ge1-\alpha\) for every sequence in \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PSRR}}\).
statements.justification: Heterogeneous effects leave the cross-potential-outcome residual covariance unidentified, and the envelope converts that obstacle into an observable conservative reference law.
statements.gap: Fiksel's covariate-adjusted interval is a Fisher-exact randomization-test inversion under an observed-data sufficient condition, while Li and Ding's conservative law and Cohen and Fogarty's Gaussian push-forward concern uniform constrained designs; none supplies the clipped first-entry PSRR weak-null envelope.
statements.consumer: Investigators using the original PSRR workflow obtain a single-run, observed-moment ATE confidence interval under heterogeneous effects without Fisher sharp-null inversion or regenerating assignments over hypothesized effects.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), the fully interacted estimator satisfies \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{Lin},n}-\tau_n)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,s^2)\). Its residual-Neyman variance based on \(\widehat u_n\) yields an asymptotically conservative Wald interval; coverage is asymptotically exact when \(u_n-s_n^2\to0\).
statements.justification: Full interactions remove the clipped covariate component only after terminal slope consistency and limiting residual independence have been established under the stopped design.
statements.gap: Lin proves this Gaussian adjustment under complete randomization, and Li--Ding and Zhao--Ding prove related cancellation under uniform constrained designs, not path-selected PSRR.
statements.consumer: Applied analysts can use standard fully interacted software and robust residual variance after an original PSRR allocation.

statements.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), if \(b=0\), then \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,s^2)\); for every \(u\ge0\), \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,0)=\sqrt u\inf\{t\ge0:\Pr(|\varepsilon|\le t)\ge1-\alpha\}\), so the envelope interval reduces to the standard conservative Neyman Gaussian form.
statements.justification: This sanity reduction verifies that the new design-specific law disappears when outcomes have no linear covariate loading.
statements.gap: The reduction is known under complete and uniform rerandomization, but it must be recovered from the stopped PSRR law rather than assumed.
statements.consumer: The result provides a diagnostic special case and connects the proposed critical value to familiar design-based Wald inference.

sampling_model.design: Original Zhu--Liu equal-allocation PSRR: uniform balanced initialization, treated--control pair proposals, Metropolis acceptance \(\min\{1,(M/M^*)^{\gamma}\}\), and immediate first entry into \(M\le a\).
sampling_model.units: A deterministic bounded finite-population triangular array with fixed \(k\); potential outcomes and covariates are fixed, assignment is the only randomness, and the deterministic retained tail \(n\ge N_0\) has positive-definite covariate covariance, positive residual scale, and a nonempty fixed-threshold acceptable allocation set. The finitely many rows below \(N_0\) are discarded.
sampling_model.treatment: Exactly \(n/2\) units receive treatment and \(n/2\) receive control; there is no interference and one version of each treatment.
sampling_model.overlap: Equal allocation gives design probabilities \(1/2\) by label-complement symmetry; no superpopulation propensity is used.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Terminal treated- and control-arm OLS projection moments estimate \(b_n\) and the conservative residual envelope \(u_n\).

estimand_functional: Along even \(n\ge N_0\), \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)\Rightarrow b^{\mathsf T}C_{k,a}+s\varepsilon\), with \(\widehat\tau_n\) the terminal observed-arm difference in means

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The authors state that it is challenging to derive the asymptotic distribution of commonly used test statistics and leave it to future work.
The estimator has a linear combination of a Gaussian random variable and truncated Gaussian random variables as its asymptotic distribution.
The stationary mass is proportional to a negative power of Mahalanobis imbalance, and a later accept--reject correction restores uniformity.
Under uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization, an estimated Gaussian-plus-truncated-Gaussian law gives conservative intervals under heterogeneous effects.
The fully interacted estimator is asymptotically most efficient and permits inference identical to complete randomization under the studied p-value designs.
A sample-based Gaussian push-forward yields asymptotically conservative weak-null inference for a broad class of rerandomized designs.
A speeded component of random-walk Metropolis converges weakly to the appropriate Langevin diffusion.
Finite-population random-partition statistics satisfy vector central limit theorems under covariance and maximal-term regularity.
The fully interacted OLS estimator is asymptotically normal and its Huber--White variance is conservative under complete randomization.
A closed-form covariate-adjusted confidence interval is obtained by inverting Fisher randomization tests, with an observed-data sufficient condition for correct randomization-based coverage.

tldr: On the deterministic tail where covariance whitening and residual standardization are valid, finite-population Gaussian initialization also implies that the fixed positive-radius acceptable set is nonempty, so original pair-switching rerandomization and its first-entry time are well defined; the finitely many exceptional rows are discarded. The kernel derives the joint allocation-score diffusion strictly before entry, treats the terminal crossing separately, identifies the terminal covariate score as a radially clipped Gaussian independent of a stationary Gaussian outcome residual, separates tuning-dependent search time from tuning-invariant first-order terminal behavior, and turns the resulting non-Gaussian ATE law into a computable variance-envelope interval under heterogeneous finite-population effects.

project_justification.gap: Zhu and Liu's Algorithm 1 proves equal-allocation unbiasedness and Fisher validity but explicitly leaves common-statistic asymptotics open. Fiksel gives a Fisher-exact covariate-adjusted randomization-inversion interval, while uniform-rerandomization theory conditions a Gaussian inside the balance region and the 2026 follow-up changes the design by running toward stationarity and applying a correction; none gives sequencewise weak-null inference from one original-PSRR first-entry run.
project_justification.niche: The unoccupied object is the proposal-time first-entry law of the original nonuniform PSRR allocation, including its joint outcome-residual path and observable weak-null uncertainty under heterogeneous effects.
project_justification.fill: The paper derives eventual nonemptiness of the acceptable set from Gaussian initialization, establishes pre-entry actual-filtration predictable characteristics with a separate terminal-crossing transfer, obtains a stopped diffusion and radial entrance law, proves stopped-arm moment consistency, constructs a worst-compatible-residual critical value, and gives a fully interacted Gaussian corollary without Markovian projected scores or outcome-residual independence.

related_work: Zhu and Liu define the exact immediate-stop PSRR algorithm and, in their Discussion, leave asymptotic distributions of common statistics open; the process and ATE theorems target that named gap. Lu, Zhang, and Zhu derive a negative-power stationary law and restore uniformity through an additional correction, which informs the transition algebra but is not the first-entry design studied here. Li, Ding, and Rubin derive the Gaussian-plus-truncated-Gaussian law for uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization; the boundary-atom proposition certifies that the original PSRR limit is a different object. Roberts, Gelman, and Gilks supply the martingale-problem diffusion template, while Li and Ding supply finite-population Gaussian initialization and moment-consistency ingredients. Li and Ding's regression-adjustment theory, Lin's fully interacted linearization, Zhao and Ding's cancellation under p-value rerandomization, and Cohen and Fogarty's Gaussian push-forward inform the analysis layer but do not supply stopped-path validity. Fiksel derives Fisher-exact covariate-adjusted confidence intervals by randomization-test inversion under an observed-data validity condition; that sharp-null inversion is distinct from the sequencewise asymptotically conservative heterogeneous-effect variance-envelope interval based on a single original-PSRR first-entry run.
technical_internal_limitation: A six-row bounded array has zero covariate--residual covariance and zero projected scores at a balanced state but a nonzero antisymmetric Metropolis-kink average. Thus a generator bound uniform over all balanced states is false. The central characteristic claim is localized along the actual uniformly initialized path and only at proposal indices \(m<T_n\), where \(M_n(W_{n,m})>a>0\); the terminal crossing is a separate exact-increment argument, and no expression containing \(D/\|D\|^2\) is used at or after absorption. The early kill test is the case \(a=1\) at \(\gamma=1\) and \(\gamma=10\): an order-one residual term, or the need for empirical-distribution convergence or extra initialization, forces a pivot. Existing exact absorption and bounded-cube calculations are diagnostics, not proofs.
honest_scope: The pre-entry joint actual-filtration characteristic lemma and its separate terminal-crossing, martingale-problem, random-clock, compact-containment, and first-hit assembly are open. The deterministic index \(N_0\) is derived from the existing positive liminf eigenvalue and residual-variance conditions together with finite-population Gaussian initialization: because \(\Pr(\|G\|^2\le a)>0\), the acceptable allocation set is nonempty for all sufficiently large even \(n\). Every inverse, whitened score, standardized score, stopping time, and asymptotic claim is defined only for even \(n\ge N_0\), and the finitely many exceptional rows \(n<N_0\) are discarded with no asymptotic role. Predictable-characteristic expansions hold only for \(m<T_n\); the terminal crossing is handled separately, with no singular radial drift evaluated at or after absorption. The positive residual lower bound is a custom design-relevance condition for a nondegenerate stationary outcome-residual coordinate and meaningful standardization; residual-degenerate sequences are outside the declared scope. The proposal claims only fixed \(k\), fixed \(a>0\), fixed finite \(\gamma\), equal arms, bounded leverage, and sequencewise asymptotic coverage. It excludes shrinking thresholds, growing dimension, divergent tuning, unequal arms, sequential enrollment, stationary or rejection-corrected variants, convergence of expected runtime, uniform approximation rates, and finite-sample exactness. Fixed tuning changes the drift and proposal-time hitting distribution; only the terminal first-order law is invariant.

novelty_justification: The two closest design sources separate cleanly by stochastic object. Zhu and Liu analyze exactly the original immediate-stop algorithm but stop at unbiasedness, a variance bound, and sharp-null randomization inference, explicitly leaving asymptotic distributions open. Lu, Zhang, and Zhu obtain tractability by running a chain toward stationarity and adding a correction that returns the uniform law. The kernel does neither: it follows the original uniformly initialized chain only to its first entrance, proves its generally non-Markov projected-score limit strictly before entry, handles the terminal crossing separately, and derives a radial boundary atom. Li--Ding--Rubin and Li--Ding are non-subsuming analysis comparators because their truncated-Gaussian and conservative-regression results require uniform constrained assignment. Fiksel's exact covariate-adjusted interval inverts Fisher randomization tests and is not a theorem-level target: the proposed interval instead gives sequencewise asymptotically conservative heterogeneous-effect coverage from one first-entry PSRR run. Focused destination searches found no paper combining original PSRR, stopped diffusion, radial entrance, and heterogeneous-effect variance-envelope inference.

_pre_d0_cursor.topic: For original equal-allocation pair-switching rerandomization on bounded finite-population triangular arrays, with fixed covariate dimension, fixed positive Mahalanobis threshold, finite Metropolis tuning, and nondegenerate outcome residual variance, derive the joint allocation-chain functional limit and its first-entry stopping law without assuming Markovian projected scores, stabilization, or outcome-residual independence. Prove that terminal standardized covariate imbalance is a radially clipped Gaussian, independent of a stationary Gaussian outcome-residual component, and that fixed tuning affects the proposal-time search clock but not the first-order terminal law. Establish stopped-design consistency of observed-arm projection moments and construct a computable variance-envelope critical value yielding sequencewise asymptotically conservative finite-population ATE intervals under heterogeneous effects; also derive the fully interacted adjusted corollary. Do not replace the original first-entry algorithm by its stationary or rejection-corrected variants, and do not claim shrinking thresholds, growing dimension, unequal arms, or finite-sample exactness. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: An all-pairs coupling keeps the search path o_p(1) in arm empirical averages from a stationary uniform shadow over n-scaled horizons, and an exact antisymmetric-score identity cancels the Metropolis acceptance kink without assuming an empirical-law limit; exact absorption and cube-generator checks support the predicted drift, diffusion, radial entrance, and the necessity of variance-envelope critical values. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove trajectory-uniform predictable-characteristic bounds and assemble joint functional convergence, opposite-pair proposal-clock conversion, compact containment, martingale-problem uniqueness, and continuous first-hit transfer for the generally non-Markov projected scores. EARLY KILL TEST: Prove the localized actual-filtration characteristic lemma at a=1 for gamma=1 and 10 while stress-testing the six-row zero-correlation witness; pivot if an order-one residual term survives or any extra empirical-distribution or initialization assumption is needed. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/exp_psrr_entrance_diffusion_ate.md.
